g.title: crate Standard UI components with theme support.
crate::button Build the themed button from a momentary toggle part.
crate::children The child lists the group components accept: a tuple of views or a `Vec`.
crate::command_palette Render a themed command palette over the shared palette behavior.
crate::data_column One data table column: title, cell text and view, order, match, width.
crate::data_table A standard keyed data table composes the one interaction model and table.
crate::data_table::builder The data table's constructor and the options a caller turns on.
crate::data_table::chrome The default regions of a data table: filter field, summary, pager, check boxes.
crate::data_table::rows Render keyed header and body cells with the table's actual part states.
crate::data_table::runtime Configure one shared model and table and compose the retained regions.
crate::data_table::types The state of a data table: its builder fields, slots and live context.
crate::dialog Render themed dialog frames while shared parts own their lifetime.
crate::disclosure Build the themed disclosure, a trigger over content it shows and hides.
crate::field Wire a visible label, hint and error to the control of a form field.
crate::helpers Share text styles used by standard control labels.
crate::inline_edit In-place renames: which item is being renamed, and the field that renames it.
crate::layer Apply theme recipe styles before caller overrides without extra nodes.
crate::list Render a themed selectable list over the shared keyed list parts.
crate::look The default recipes: the core's look, made only of the theme's tokens.
crate::look_collections Default recipes for the list and the data table.
crate::look_controls Default recipes for the radio group, slider, toasts and splitter.
crate::look_extra Default recipes for standard multi-part components.
crate::look_input Default recipes for the tag input and the number input.
crate::look_palette Default recipes for the command palette.
crate::menu Render themed menus recursively over shared menu level parts.
crate::number_input Render a themed number field with decrease and increase buttons.
crate::progress Build the themed progress bar from its value and the motion it shows.
crate::radio_group Render a themed radio group over the shared keyed list parts.
crate::recipes Passive function tables define every standard component's theme recipes.
crate::select Render a themed select using the shared keyed selection parts.
crate::slider Render themed sliders over the shared scalar track and thumb parts.
crate::split Render panes sized by fractions with a themed splitter handle between each pair.
crate::splitter Render two themed panes and the shared splitter handle between them.
crate::tabs Render a shared themed tab list with optional selected panel lifetime.
crate::tag_input Render a themed field of removable tags and a text input to add one.
crate::text_draft A text input that edits a draft: Enter commits, Escape and blur end it.
crate::toast Render the App's toasts in themed live regions.
crate::toggle Build themed binary toggles from their actual interaction part state.
crate::toggle_button Build the themed toggle button from its actual interaction part state.
crate::tooltip Style shared tooltip surface and trigger parts without owning timers.
crate::values Passive state and appearance settings for standard component recipes.
crate::variants Kit-defined variants every standard component passes to its recipes.
